user.title: Goatee Continue
user.description: Select the Ecovacs GOAT mower to add a resume/continue capability for. This reuses the official Ecovacs integration's session — no second login.

abort.ecovacs_not_loaded: The official Ecovacs integration is not set up. Add it first, then add Goatee Continue.
abort.no_devices: No compatible Ecovacs devices were found. Make sure the official Ecovacs integration is loaded and your GOAT is online.

resume.name: Resume (continue) mowing
resume.description: Continue the paused, unfinished mowing task from where it left off (sends act: r, like the app's Continue button). Does not restart the map.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Ecovacs device(s) to resume. Defaults to all configured GOATs.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Lawn mower entity(ies) whose device should be resumed.
